# Sri Easwari Scientific Solution Pvt Ltd (SESS)

> Manufacturer of environmental test chambers in Chennai, India, since 2010. SESS designs, builds, installs and services climatic, thermal shock, thermal cycling, salt spray, battery, rain, dust, vibration, walk-in, tabletop and tensile test chambers, and provides LabVIEW/PLC automation and IT solutions.

Contact: sales@sess.co.in · +91 94444 27748 · Iyyappanthangal, Chennai 600 122, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Products

- [All environmental test chambers](https://www.sess.co.in/products): overview of the full product range
- [Climatic Test Chamber](https://www.sess.co.in/climatic-test-chamber): temperature and humidity testing (IEC 60068-2-1/-2/-30/-78)
- [Thermal Shock Chamber](https://www.sess.co.in/thermal-shock-chamber): two-zone rapid hot/cold transfer testing
- [Thermal Cyclic Chamber](https://www.sess.co.in/thermal-cyclic-chamber): rapid temperature change and stress screening (IEC 60068-2-14)
- [Salt Spray Test Chamber](https://www.sess.co.in/salt-spray-test-chamber): corrosion testing (ISO 9227, IS 9000)
- [Battery Test Chamber](https://www.sess.co.in/battery-test-chamber): EV and lithium-ion cell, module and pack testing
- [Rain Test Chamber](https://www.sess.co.in/rain-test-chamber): IPX1–IPX9K water ingress testing (IEC 60529, ISO 20653)
- [Dust Test Chamber](https://www.sess.co.in/dust-chamber): IP5X/IP6X dust ingress testing (IEC 60529, ISO 20653)
- [Vibration Combined Climatic Chamber](https://www.sess.co.in/vibration-test-chamber): combined vibration, temperature and humidity testing
- [Walk-In Chamber](https://www.sess.co.in/walk-in-chamber): room-size temperature and humidity chambers
- [Tabletop Test Chamber](https://www.sess.co.in/tabletop-test-chamber): compact benchtop climatic chamber
- [Tensile Test Chamber](https://www.sess.co.in/tensile-chamber): temperature chamber for universal testing machines (UTM)
- [Flame Proof Hot Air Oven](https://www.sess.co.in/flame-proof-hot-air-oven): drying and heating for hazardous areas
